newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: TABLE-NZ ADRs mostly fail to respond to Dow surge.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-NZ ADRs mostly fail to respond to Dow surge.

text.p: Apart from Telecom and Fletcher Challenge Building, New Zealand ADRs failed to respond to the Dow's surge on Fed chairman Alan Greenspan's comments.
In late New York trade as the Dow Jones Industrial Index was up 140.3 points to 8047 at 7.45 a.m. NZT..
Price movements of NZ stocks listed in the U.S. and Australia.

Notes - In New York, Telecom's American Depository Receipts are traded in bundles of eight shares, while both the Fletcher Challenge shares are in bundles of 10 each. Tranz Rail ADSs are groups of three ordinary shares.
- Asterisk * means stock is still trading
